name: Redline — Strings of Fate
source:
A sci-fi romance visual novel set in a near-future coastal city in southern Japan where gifted individuals can perceive, interpret, and influence human emotions — abilities now at the center of scientific research and corporate ambition.

You play as a university student with the rare ability to perceive emotional connections as red threads. As you become entangled in a secretive research program and drawn toward five distinct love interests, your choices will shape not only your relationships, but the fate of society itself. 

[From [url=https://moterugames.itch.io/redline-strings-of-fate]itch.io[/url]]
